files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.

Define node IntegrationConfig with fields config_id, provider, label, api_key, secret_key, webhook_secret, rpc_url, treasury_wallet, usdc_contract, chain_id (all str, default ""), enabled: bool = True, mode: str = "test" and updated_at: str = "". postinit sets updated_at to datetime.now().isoformat() when it is empty.

signatures.IntegrationConfig: node IntegrationConfig { has config_id: str = ""; has provider: str = ""; has label: str = ""; has api_key: str = ""; has secret_key: str = ""; has webhook_secret: str = ""; has rpc_url: str = ""; has treasury_wallet: str = ""; has usdc_contract: str = ""; has chain_id: str = ""; has enabled: bool = True; has mode: str = "test"; has updated_at: str = ""; def postinit; }

files.purpose: Define node Platform with platform_id: str = "platform", name, environment, default_chain, default_asset (str, default ""), status: str = "active" and created_at: str = "". postinit fills each empty field: name = os.getenv("PLATFORM_NAME") or "FILL_ME_PLATFORM_NAME"; environment = os.getenv("APP_ENV") or "dev"; default_chain = os.getenv("DEFAULT_CHAIN") or "base"; default_asset = os.getenv("DEFAULT_ASSET") or "USDC"; created_at = datetime.now().isoformat().

signatures.Platform: node Platform { has platform_id: str = "platform"; has name: str = ""; has environment: str = ""; has default_chain: str = ""; has default_asset: str = ""; has status: str = "active"; has created_at: str = ""; def postinit; }

files.purpose: Import IntegrationConfig from nodes.IntegrationConfig. env_or returns os.getenv(env_name) when it is non-empty, otherwise fallback (an empty string counts as unset). ensure_config scans [root-->][?:IntegrationConfig] for the config whose provider matches; if found it overwrites label, api_key, secret_key, webhook_secret, rpc_url, treasury_wallet, usdc_contract, chain_id and mode with the call's arguments (omitted ones take their defaults, so earlier values are cleared), sets updated_at to now in ISO format and returns that same node; otherwise it connects a new IntegrationConfig(config_id=provider + "_config", provider and all the arguments) to root and returns the new node. seed_demo_config calls ensure_config three times and returns [stripe, wallets, rpc] in that order: provider "stripe" with label "Stripe Checkout", api_key env_or("STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY", "pk_test_FILL_ME_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY"), secret_key env_or("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY", "sk_test_FILL_ME_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"), webhook_secret env_or("STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "whsec_FILL_ME_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET"); provider "wallet_provider" with label env_or("WALLET_PROVIDER_NAME", "FILL_ME_WALLET_PROVIDER"), api_key env_or("WALLET_PROVIDER_API_KEY", "FILL_ME_WALLET_PROVIDER_API_KEY"), secret_key env_or("WALLET_PROVIDER_SECRET", "FILL_ME_WALLET_PROVIDER_SECRET"), treasury_wallet env_or("TREASURY_WALLET", "0xFILL_ME_TREASURY_WALLET"); provider "rpc" with label env_or("DEFAULT_CHAIN", "Base RPC"), rpc_url env_or("RPC_URL", "https://FILL_ME_RPC_URL"), usdc_contract env_or("USDC_CONTRACT", "0xFILL_ME_USDC_CONTRACT"), chain_id env_or("CHAIN_ID", "8453"); all three use mode env_or("APP_MODE", "test") and leave the other arguments at their defaults. list_configs returns every IntegrationConfig directly under root.

signatures.env_or: def env_or(env_name: str, fallback: str) -> str
signatures.ensure_config: def ensure_config(provider: str, label: str, api_key: str = "", secret_key: str = "", webhook_secret: str = "", rpc_url: str = "", treasury_wallet: str = "", usdc_contract: str = "", chain_id: str = "8453", mode: str = "test") -> IntegrationConfig

files.purpose: Import seed_demo_config from config, IntegrationConfig from nodes.IntegrationConfig and Platform from nodes.Platform. get_platform_node takes the first Platform directly under root, refreshes name = os.getenv("PLATFORM_NAME") or its current name or "FILL_ME_PLATFORM_NAME", environment = os.getenv("APP_ENV") or current or "dev", default_chain = os.getenv("DEFAULT_CHAIN") or current or "base", default_asset = os.getenv("DEFAULT_ASSET") or current or "USDC", and returns it; when none exists it connects a new Platform() to root and returns it, so root holds a single Platform. bootstrap_platform calls get_platform_node and seed_demo_config and returns a dict with keys platform_id (jid of the Platform), name, environment, default_chain, default_asset, config_count (len of the seeded list, i.e. 3) and env_keys, a 15-entry dict mapping each lowercase key to its environment-variable name: platform_name PLATFORM_NAME, app_env APP_ENV, app_mode APP_MODE, default_chain DEFAULT_CHAIN, default_asset DEFAULT_ASSET, stripe_publishable_key STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, stripe_secret_key STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, stripe_webhook_secret STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, wallet_provider_name WALLET_PROVIDER_NAME, wallet_provider_api_key WALLET_PROVIDER_API_KEY, wallet_provider_secret WALLET_PROVIDER_SECRET, treasury_wallet TREASURY_WALLET, rpc_url RPC_URL, usdc_contract USDC_CONTRACT, chain_id CHAIN_ID. get_platform_overview calls get_platform_node only (no seeding) and returns platform_id, name, environment, default_chain, default_asset and merchant_count = len([root-->]), the count of all nodes directly under root; it has no config_count key.

Thin entry module that only imports env_or, ensure_config, seed_demo_config, list_configs from config and get_platform_node, bootstrap_platform, get_platform_overview from app_platform so they are registered and importable from main.

signatures.config: import from config { env_or, ensure_config, seed_demo_config, list_configs }
signatures.app_platform: import from app_platform { get_platform_node, bootstrap_platform, get_platform_overview }

verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and Jac behavior tests that set or remove environment variables with os.environ, use unique provider and platform names, and lower-bound root child counts because the graph root persists across tests.

assumption: Backend slice of Wally-Ahmed/JacHacks2026 (Uni-bank): the platform/configuration modules. Merchant, invoice, payment, wallet and settlement services are out of scope (they need Stripe/Circle subprocess calls or do not type-check).
